description:
T6 (TPO367)- London Plane, Platanus hispanicus removal of limb on east side of crown infected with Massaria.  Limb is above a gate into Charterhouse Square.
The affected limb overhangs the busy public pavement and gate into Charterhouse Square.  This presents a high risk of injury or death to the pedestrians walking beneath the limb.   Therefore removing branch mitigates the risk
T7 (TPO 367)- London Plane, Platanus hispanicus removal of limb on east side of crown infected with Massaria.  Limb overhangs busy pavement on  Charterhouse street.
The affected limb overhangs the busy public pavement and gate into Charterhouse Square.  This presents a high risk of injury or death to the pedestrians walking beneath the limb. Therefore removing branch mitigates the risk
T14- (TPO 367) London Plane Platanus hispanicus removal of limb on east side of crown infected with Massaria.  Limb overhangs path junction and benches in Charterhouse Square.
The affected limb overhangs an internal path and is above a bench.  The path is the main route from the charterhouse to the Barbican and the bench is used by visitors to sit on.  This presents a high risk of injury or death to the pedestrians/ sitters under the branch. Therefore removing branch mitigates the risk
